pawleys-island-north-end.what: A wide, flat beach at low tide in the foreground; a row of raised two- and three-story houses along the dune line at left; the inlet and the far shore with more houses at right; big cumulus clouds. A few people far off and too small to recognize.
pawleys-island-north-end.caption: The north end of Pawleys Island at low tide: houses along the dune line, and the inlet at right.
pawleys-island-north-end.alt: A wide beach at low tide with a row of raised houses along the dunes and an inlet beyond
